svg.text: Withdrawal is normal, and it is not increasing
Every GRAS notice FDA closed in each year, by outcome. A notice is “withdrawn” when FDA records that, at the notifier’s request, it ceased to evaluate.
Source: FDA GRAS Notice Inventory, gras-notices-2026-09-11.csv. 1,336 notices, GRN 1–1336. 2026 is a partial year.
no basis for a GRAS determination
The rate ranges from 0% to 33% with no trend across 28 years, on a mean of 17.2%. Reading any single year as a signal is reading noise.
Years with fewer than 8 closures omitted. Outcome is FDA's own letter text, classified verbatim.
